description: List configured runtime host names and their capability flags. SSH destinations and credentials are never accepted from tool input.
name: host_list
title: Host List

description: Read bounded effective Hepta capabilities and configured host aliases from a strict allowlist projection. Returns authorization switches and counts, never SSH destinations, private paths, credentials, environment values, privileged commands or raw policy. Does not modify configuration; administrator changes require reviewed version-controlled configuration and rollback.
name: effective_config
title: Read Redacted Effective Configuration

description: Validate and hash a canonical execution_intent v1 against an allowlisted host. Shadow only: never starts a process, grants FinalUse or acknowledges an effect.
name: execution_shadow_admit
title: Execution Shadow Admission

description: Read files, list directories, search content. Lines render as `N:hh|content`; copy `N:hh` verbatim — it is the line id edit tools target. Listings are recursive and gitignore-aware, one `path	NL	~Nt` (lines, ~tokens) per file. Re-viewing a whole file returns only the hunks changed since your last view (or an unchanged marker); ranged reads always return the requested lines. Reuse returned content: read a complete block in one call, combine adjacent windows, never re-read overlapping ranges or narrow one just to pick edit targets; re-read only when the file may have changed or output was truncated.

content.description:
Locate code: searches the whole file/tree (`start`/`end` ignored) for a literal
substring, or a Rust regex with `regex: true` (`(?i)` case-insensitive; alternation for
related terms).

end.description:
Last line (inclusive): line id or integer (negative counts from the end). Default: end
of file; omit both `start` and `end` for the whole file.

full.description:
Force the complete file when re-viewing a whole file (normally only changed hunks),
e.g. after losing earlier context. No effect on ranges or searches; output limits
unchanged.

max_depth.description:
Directory depth bound. Default: unlimited, except a bare remote listing (no
`pattern`/`content`) stops at the root entries. Searches walk the whole tree.

path.description:
File or directory. `a|b` searches several roots with `content` (max 32); several
files take parallel view calls. Remote: ssh://[user@]host[:port]/path (host may be an
~/.ssh/config alias; `ssh://host` or `ssh://host/~/dir` is the login home).

pattern.description:
Ripgrep -g globs bounding listings and searches: without `/` a name at any depth,
with `/` the relative path; `*`, `**`, `?`, `[abc]`, `{rs,toml}`, leading `!`; `|`
joins ordered globs (later wins), e.g. `**/*.rs|!target/**`. Applied after
gitignore/hidden filtering; one line, max 4096 bytes, 64 globs.

regex.description: Treat `content` as a regex. Default: false.

start.description:
First line (inclusive): line id or integer (negative counts from the end, -1 = last).
Default: line 1.

name: view
title: View

description: Switch the working directory for later calls (`path`) or revert to the session root (`reset: true`). Every tool resolves relative paths against it; do not call it just to check the directory. A remote (ssh://) workdir disables `shell`.

path.description:
Directory to switch into, absolute or relative to the current workdir; required unless
`reset`. Not `"."` (a no-op). Remote: ssh://user@host:port/path; `ssh://host` or
`ssh://host/~/dir` is the login home.

name: workdir
title: Working Directory

description: Create a directory tree only inside the configured controller-local workspace. Existing directories succeed without change, while files or symlink components are refused. No command execution, remote host selection, privilege escalation or overwrite. Linux only.

path.description: Directory path in the configured local controller workspace. Remote paths are refused.

name: directory_create
title: Create Workspace Directory

description: Move one regular file between two configured controller-local workspace paths. Never overwrite an existing destination or follow source/parent symlinks. Requires an existing destination parent and same-device atomic rename support; no copy/delete fallback. This removes the old filename but retains the file inode. Linux only.

destination.description: Absent destination path with an existing non-symlink parent directory.

source.description: Existing local ordinary file to move, never a symlink or directory.

name: file_move
title: Move Workspace File Without Overwrite

description: Atomically rename one existing controller-local directory tree inside configured workspace roots to an absent target path. Existing destination, symlinked parents/source, missing destination parent and cross-device moves are refused. This moves an entire directory tree without traversing its entries and removes the original pathname. No shell, remote host, privilege escalation or copy/delete fallback. Linux only; not a transaction with independent writers.

destination.description: Absent target directory path with an existing authorized parent.

source.description: Existing controller-local workspace directory, never a symlink or file.

name: directory_move
title: Move Workspace Directory Without Overwrite
